subject: literacy
concept: Writing a satisfying ending that resolves the story's problem in a way that makes sense
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares an abrupt, unearned ending to a resolved, earned one for the same story setup
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a story's problem to the ending that resolves it logically
exercise.abstract: Student writes an ending for a story that resolves its central problem

misconception_flags: writes an ending unconnected to the story's actual problem (e.g. resolved by pure luck with no setup)

interest_binding: story content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
